name: dsh-session-rescue
description: Prevents the DeepSeek Harness cold-start turn stall: after a restart or session load the first turn can block forever while the token meter synchronously replays the whole session log; this plugin compacts the session before its size reaches that danger zone, so the replay stays cheap.

scripts.typecheck: node --check src/host.js && node --check src/guard.js && node --check src/size.js && node --check src/detect.js && node --check src/frames.js
scripts.test: node --test test/size.test.js test/guard.test.js test/detect.test.js test/frames.test.js test/host.test.js
